regimen_or_test: personalized mRNA neoantigen vaccine autogene cevumeran + atezolizumab lead-in + mFOLFIRINOX
patient_gate: resected PDAC; enough manufacturable class I/II neoantigens; low-burden post-operative window
key_result: At 3.2-year median follow-up, vaccine-induced T-cell responders had median RFS not reached versus 13.4 months in non-responders; HR 0.14; P=0.007
status: Phase 1, small n, randomized phase 2 ongoing
implication: Best current clinical anchor for personalized PDAC vaccine strategy; use as benchmark for timing and response biomarkers

regimen_or_test: ELI-002 2P lymph-node targeted amphiphile KRAS G12D/G12R vaccine + CpG adjuvant
patient_gate: MRD-positive after locoregional therapy; KRAS G12D or G12R; ECOG 0-1; no radiographic disease dominant
key_result: Final phase 1: n=25, 20 PDAC; mKRAS T-cell response above 9.17-fold associated with RFS not reached vs 3.02 months; HR 0.12; P=0.0002
status: Phase 1 final; ELI-002 7P randomized phase 2 ongoing
implication: Strong off-the-shelf/public-neoantigen MRD backbone; more scalable than individualized vaccine

regimen_or_test: pooled mutant KRAS long-peptide vaccine covering G12V/G12A/G12R/G12C/G12D/G13D + nivolumab + ipilimumab
patient_gate: resected PDAC; tumor has one of six KRAS mutations; fit for dual checkpoint toxicity
key_result: 12 treated; grade 1-2 vaccine AEs; 2/12 grade 3 immune-related AEs from checkpoint; 11/12 average mKRAS immune responders; 10/12 tumor-matched responders
implication: Proof that pooled KRAS + dual checkpoint can be immunogenic, but toxicity and small-n DFS signal need careful selection

regimen_or_test: autogene cevumeran + atezolizumab + mFOLFIRINOX versus mFOLFIRINOX alone
patient_gate: resected T1-T3/N0-N2/M0 PDAC; no prior systemic therapy; no evidence of disease after surgery
key_result: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05968326 phase 2 open-label randomized study
implication: The right comparator trial to track before making any definitive clinical claim

regimen_or_test: ELI-002 7P amphiphile vaccine, seven KRAS/NRAS peptides
patient_gate: KRAS/NRAS G12/G13-mutated solid tumors, especially high-risk PDAC
key_result: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05726864 phase 1/2; seven-peptide formulation includes KRAS/NRAS G12D/R/V/S/A/C and G13D
implication: Best public-neoantigen trial to track for scalable PDAC vaccine translation

patient_gate: BRAF V600E-positive locally advanced/metastatic ATC; no satisfactory locoregional option
key_result: FDA approval based on ATC cohort ORR 61%; response duration at least 6 months in 64% of responders
implication: For BRAF-mutant ATC, vaccine/ICI concepts should build around MAPK-targeted backbone, not replace it

patient_gate: BRAF V600E ATC; fit for checkpoint; ideally trial/experienced center
key_result: Retrospective signal reported median OS 17.0 months with triplet versus 9.0 months with doublet; P=0.04
implication: Best current immunotherapy-combo clue in ATC; use as checkpoint backbone hypothesis for antigen-positive patients

patient_gate: progressive RAI-refractory DTC; either lenvatinib-naive or progressed on lenvatinib
key_result: Phase 2: cohort 1 ORR 65.5%, median PFS 26.8 months; cohort 2 ORR 16%, median PFS 10.0 months
implication: For DTC/PDTC, anti-VEGF/TKI + PD-1 is stronger near-term combo backbone than vaccine alone

patient_gate: BRAF V600E-negative ATC; ECOG 0-2; trial-specific biopsy and disease criteria
implication: Non-BRAF ATC combo direction: multi-kinase/RAS-MAPK-VEGF-axis inhibitor + PD-1

regimen_or_test: THCA neoantigen/HLA triage + Paper 1/2/3 immune-state integration
patient_gate: HLA typed; tumor-normal sequencing/RNA; HLA LOH/B2M intact; immune-active HT/TLS/IFN axis preferred
key_result: Local pages: THCA corpus n=2,989; low TMB; A*24:02 Korean gap; Paper 3 ATC myeloid/thyroid-diff axis; Paper 2 HT/TLS axis
implication: THCA is a patient-selection problem first; avoid vaccine-first claims for low-risk PTC

regimen_or_test: leakage-aware class I/II neoantigen prioritization; CLEAN-Neo blueprint
patient_gate: strict no-overlap benchmark; HLA pseudo-seq; WT-mut delta; expression; clonality; uncertainty
key_result: Current frozen ESM2/Bayesian model does not rescue ITSNdb no-overlap AUROC; best value is abstention/uncertainty
implication: Use neoantigen model as triage + uncertainty, not as definitive immunogenicity proof
